title: Model A — manual multi-step (initiator orchestrates two sequential intents)
description: The initiator orchestrates two sequential intents without a server-side workflow. Step 1: sends to order-validator-agent, waits for result. Step 2: takes the result (validation_score) and sends to order-executor-agent with the score embedded in the payload. The executor only proceeds if score >= 70. Tests agent-to-agent chaining driven by the client, not the server.

agents.description: step 1/2: validates order fields, returns validation_score
step 2/2: executes order using validation_score from step 1

second_intent._note: runner merges step 1 result (validation_score) into this payload before sending
